delivered.text:
**Revises an earlier Kody suggestion** on `src/billing/status.ts:8` (2026-09-30 00:46 UTC).

Now that `fetchStatus` propagates `NotReadyError`, `pollCharge` at `src/billing/polling/poller.ts:11` catches it and calls `gw.submit`, which the `Gateway` interface documents as non-idempotent, so every polling tick resubmits while the charge remains not ready and creates duplicate charges. Skip `gw.submit` on `NotReadyError` and wait for the next tick, only calling it when there is a genuine new charge to submit.
